principles.text: Use the constrained DSL and selected spec. Match the bundled blode-icons references: 2-unit outlined strokes, round caps and joins, radius-3 corners on containers and simple interior details. Keep each mark optically balanced within its host. Inspect native proofs; structural checks do not establish craft approval.
